title: stardust rollout/coverage/pages.json
description: Delivery ledger: one row per migrated page rollout is responsible for delivering to AEM-EDS. Built by inventorying stardust/migrated/. Tracks the source hash (for stale detection), per-page delivery status and, once a page's content document exists, the delivered block structure (`delivered`). Owned by stardust:rollout; the agnostic core is never modified. Part of the coverage contract a client reads: strict here because it describes exactly what stardust writes.

excluded.description: Planned pages the source no longer serves (state.mjs exclude), by slug: never in pages[], so never in a denominator, a pass or a fail. Present only when there is one.

caseCollisions.description: Pages whose content file exists under both the row's own case and its delivered-path fold (inventory.mjs): `file` is read (the exact one), `alternate` is the fold; the two collide once delivered, so one must go. Present only when there is one.

file.description: Content-relative path of the file read (the row's own case).

alternate.description: Content-relative path of the other file (the delivered-path fold).

formatVersion.description: Coverage format version (semver). Before 1.0.0 a release may still change the shape; from 1.0.0 (declared once a client has shipped against it) a minor release only adds fields, clients ignore fields they do not know, and removing or renaming a field is a major release. Writers since stardust 0.34.0 always emit it; files written earlier lack it.

path.description: Destination path on the delivered site, e.g. /blog/scaling-teams.

templateId.description: The template grouping this page belongs to (rollout/coverage/templates.json[].id). Drives delivery order and block reuse.

representative.description: Archetypes-only mode (--state): the slug of the archetype a content-pending roster sibling clones; null when none matched.

migratedHtml.description: Path, e.g. stardust/migrated/blog/scaling-teams.html; `<origin>:<slug>` for a row added outside the migrated tree (update-coverage.mjs --new); null for an archetypes-only roster sibling.

currentStatePath.description: Archetypes-only roster sibling: the state.json currentStatePath its source hash was taken from, when that file exists.

sourceUrl.description: The page's URL on the source site (sidecar, else state.json by slug): the join key with a spec's knowledge.

sourceHash.description: Content hash of the migrated HTML; changes mark the page stale for re-delivery.

encodedHtml.description: An encoded page (migrate's encoder): the encoded document deploy stages, stardust/encoded/<da-path>.html (`migratedHtml` is then null); absent on every other row.

variance.description: A cloned sibling's sibling-variance record, copied verbatim from its sidecar (migrate owns the shape: the verdict with its deltas and acceptance, or why the check was skipped); absent when the sidecar has none.

widgets.description: Widgets this page mounts (sidecar widgets[]): id = the EDS widget name (rollout/coverage/blocks.json[].id, kind widget), href = the one /widgets/<path>/<name>.html link the page carries, query params included.

delivered.description: The delivered page's block structure, parsed from its content document; null while the page has no content document.

blocks.description: Records in document order: block instances and merged runs of default content.

sections.description: Sections holding at least one record, in document order.

lang.description: The page's language from its sidecar metadata; null when unknown.

sourceSnapshot.description: Path of the committed source DOM snapshot (stardust/current/pages/<slug>.html) when it exists, else null.

contentHash.description: Hash of the content document's bytes; a mismatch with the file on disk means the coverage is stale.

status.description: stale = source hash changed after a prior delivery; needs re-delivery. content-pending = an archetypes-only roster sibling that pushes no document of its own.

record.description: One record of the delivered page, the page-block shape the spec skill also uses. kind block: a block div (block = its first class, variant = its classes joined by a space or null, variantId, rows and cells set). kind default: consecutive default content in one section merged into one record (block default-content, variant = its parts in order of first appearance joined by +, classes [], variantId, rows and cells null).

pos.description: 0-based document order over the page's records of both kinds.

variant.description: kind block: the classes joined by a space, or null. kind default: parts (heading, separator, image, video, button, link-list, text) joined by +.

section.description: Style of the enclosing section, or null (the spec skill's meaning).

sectionPos.description: pos of the enclosing section in delivered.sections.

classes.description: Option classes (all classes but the first), unique and sorted; [] for default content.

variantId.description: kind block: v_ plus 12 hex of a sha256 over the block name and its classes, carried forward from the prior pages.json when it differs; null for default content.

rows.description: Element children of the block div; null for default content.

cells.description: Element-child count of each row; null for default content.

style.description: The section-metadata style, trimmed; null when none.

blocks.description: pos of the records in this section.

gate.description: The page's verdict from the published-origin pixel gate (update-coverage.mjs --gate); verify.mjs never marks a page verified while pass is false.

pass.description: Passed, or a documented override applies.

inconclusive.description: A row without a verdict (a polluted capture): its reasons joined by '; ' (`no verdict` when none) — recorded pass false, the status never flipped; null for a row that has a verdict.

override.description: gate-all's validated override when the row carries one — {verdict, reason, valid}; only valid true passes a failing row — else null. A plain string is the older verdict-only form.

reason.description: Cites the inconsistency-register entry (R-<nn>) that documents the deviation.

table.description: Path of the gate summary the verdict came from.

at.description: Row time: a whole-row reuse's time, else the table's writtenAt; null when the table records neither (such a row is never skipped as older).

width.description: The table's breakpoint in px (_provenance.breakpoint); null when the table records none.

atByWidth.description: The newest applied row time per width ({"<width>": ISO time}); a row older than its width's time is skipped, so an older table never reverts a newer verdict.

passByWidth.description: Each width's own verdict ({"<width>": true | false | null}); null = an inconclusive row at that width (no verdict). done-check proves a page only when every width is true.

rounds.description: The fix-round count per width ({"<width>": n}), the newest applied row of a width setting it.

host.description: The EDS origin (scheme + host) the row was measured against: the row's own, else its table's _provenance.eds; null when neither records one.
